{{Short description|Chinese researcher}}
'''Ai Guoxiang''' (February 1938), who publishes as '''Guoxiang Ai''', is a Chinese [[researcher]], [[inventor]], and [[astronomist]] who specialises in [[space astronomy|space astronomy research]] and [[solar physics]]. He was a past President of the [[National Astronomical Observatories of China]] and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Ai Wang Wang 2012 p. ">{{cite journal | last1=Ai | first1=Guoxiang | last2=Wang | first2=Huaning | last3=Wang | first3=Jingxiu | title=What Is a Solar Electromagnetic Storm? | journal=Space Weather | volume=10 | issue=9 | date=2012 | issn=1542-7390 | doi=10.1029/2012SW000847 | page=| bibcode=2012SpWea..10.9003A }}</ref><ref name="Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences i168">{{cite web | title=Division of Mathematics and Physics---Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences | website=Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences | url=http://english.casad.cas.cn/mem/divsions/domap/ | access-date=2024-02-17 | archive-date=2016-11-08 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161108193217/http://english.casad.cas.cn/mem/divsions/domap/ | url-status=dead }}</ref>  

==Education and career==
Guoxiang was educated at Ming De Middle School, [[Changsha, China]] and graduated in 1963 from the Department of [[Geophysics]] at the [[Peking University]] and joined the National Observatories of China. He received the First prize of Chinese National Science and Technology Progress Award in 1987 for inventing the [[Solar telescope|Solar Magnetic Field Telescope]] and his research of the solar magnetic field and velocity filed has won the [[State Science and Technology Prizes]] (formerly the Natural Science Award).<ref name="sourcedb.naoc.cas.cn s857">{{cite web | title=专家人才库数据----National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences | website=sourcedb.naoc.cas.cn | url=http://sourcedb.naoc.cas.cn/en/enaoexpert/200907/t20090706_2000391.html | access-date=2024-02-17}}</ref> He is a member of the Shaw Prize's selection committee.<ref name="The Shaw Prize 2023 x302">{{cite web | title=Archive of Past Selection Committees | website=The Shaw Prize | date=2023-06-07 | url=https://www.shawprize.org/about/archive-of-past-selection-committees/ | access-date=2024-02-17}}</ref>
